name: Piccolo on-screen keyboard
author: Jorge Cohen
description: Touch/on-screen keyboard for the Omarchy shell (Hyprland). Pops up on text-field focus via fcitx5 or an edge swipe; real Ctrl/Alt/Super chords through ydotool so punctuation and Super binds work everywhere; symbols/function layer, cursor-drag space bar, optional dictation; shares its key surface with the lock screen.
